facts.text: I am trying to gather information about the resettlement process for my family, who will be arriving in Canada soon.
My family will be arriving in Canada soon.
I have been busy lately with meetings and prep work for my own refugee claim hearing.
My refugee claim hearing is coming up on March 20th.
I just got the call to schedule my refugee claim hearing last week.

I want to understand the payment structure for the Resettlement Assistance Program (RAP).
I want to know how the one-time payment is distributed over 12 months.
I want to know whether the monthly amount is fixed or varies based on my family's needs.
I am worried about how my family will adjust to life in Canada, especially my kids.
I am taking English language classes at a local community center.
I am not sure if my English language classes are enough to prepare me for my refugee claim hearing.
I have a meeting with my lawyer, Mrs. Smith, soon to discuss my case.

My lawyer, Mrs. Smith, advised me to provide as much evidence as possible to support my claim.
